capabilities: : Converts Pandoc citations into formatted references
: Reads reference libraries from Zotero or Better BibTeX
: Displays formatted citations in the note text
: Builds and displays reference lists in the sidebar
intentEvidence: It is a maintained fork of Pandoc Reference List by Matthew Meyers, which is no longer maintained.
motivation: The author built it to maintain the functionality of the original Pandoc Reference List plugin, which is no longer maintained.
problem: Users need a way to automatically generate and display formatted reference lists based on Pandoc citations and external reference libraries.

relations.evidence: It is a maintained fork of Pandoc Reference List by Matthew Meyers, which is no longer maintained.

summary: A plugin that converts Pandoc citations into formatted references, displaying them in the text and a sidebar list.
